title: FAANG Interview Readiness Assessment
subtitle: Find out how prepared you are for senior-level tech interviews

questions.question: How confident are you in structuring STAR stories for leadership principles?

options.text: Very confident - I have 15+ polished stories
Somewhat confident - I have a few good examples
Not very confident - I struggle with structure
Not at all - I don't know what STAR means

questions.question: Can you design a distributed system like YouTube or Uber from scratch?

options.text: Yes, with detailed trade-offs and scaling strategies
Mostly, but I miss some components
I can do basic designs but struggle with scale
I haven't practiced system design interviews

questions.question: How do you handle 'Tell me about a time you failed' questions?

options.text: I have compelling failure stories with strong learnings
I can answer but struggle to show growth
I tend to avoid admitting real failures
I freeze up on these questions

questions.question: How comfortable are you explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders?

options.text: Very comfortable - I do this regularly
Comfortable with preparation
I struggle to simplify technical jargon
I prefer talking to technical people only

questions.question: Do you know your market value and how to negotiate offers?

options.text: Yes, I've negotiated multiple offers successfully
I have some idea but haven't negotiated much
I usually accept the first offer given
I have no idea how to negotiate

questions.question: How well do you research companies before interviews?

options.text: Extensively - culture, leadership principles, recent news
Basic research - website, job description
Minimal research - just the role
I don't research much beforehand

questions.question: How many mock interviews have you done in the past 3 months?

options.text: 10+ with experienced interviewers
5-10 with peers or online platforms
1-4 casual practice sessions
None - I plan to wing it

questions.question: Can you quantify your impact with specific metrics (revenue, users, efficiency)?

options.text: Yes, I have metrics for all major projects
For some projects, but not all
I struggle to find measurable impact
I've never thought about quantifying impact

questions.question: How do you perform under pressure during interviews?

options.text: I thrive under pressure and think clearly
I manage okay but get nervous
I often blank out or rush answers
I panic and can't think straight

questions.question: Do you have a compelling 2-minute career narrative?

options.text: Yes, polished and practiced
I have a rough version
I ramble when telling my story
I've never prepared one
